editorial.blurb: A lively West Town seafood spot where fresh catches meet warm hospitality, with portions that won't leave you wondering what happened to your money.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the fried red snapper with the spicy garlic sauce on the side—it transforms the fresh fish perfectly—and don't skip the garlic bread for dipping in leftover sauce; arrive during lunch to experience the bustling local crowd and quick service.
signatureDishes: Fried red snapper with spicy garlic sauce
